name: @btkulka/data-sync
description: An app's SQLite data on every machine of Ben's without a server: before serving, an app looks on the tailnet for a copy of itself already running and attaches to it (its own port proxies there); otherwise it pulls the newest snapshot from the Syncthing folder and serves, pushing a byte-stable SQL snapshot after each change. Two machines that both changed are never merged: the local copy is backed up and the choice is Ben's. Works on a better-sqlite3 Database or a node:sqlite DatabaseSync that the app hands in.
